title: Handover
description: What did the last shift leave?

loadFailed.title: The handover could not be loaded.
loadFailed.network: The backend did not answer. Retry; if it keeps failing, check that the backend is reachable.
loadFailed.forbidden: Your account may not read the handover log. Ask an administrator for access.
loadFailed.expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
loadFailed.server: The backend failed while reading the handover. Retry; if it keeps failing, check the backend log.
loadFailed.notFound: This handover does not exist. It may have been removed by retention.

empty.text: No handover yet. The queue lists what is waiting.

record.openEmpty: No open rows were frozen. Check the source lines below before reading this as an empty queue.
record.openEmptyClean: No open rows were waiting when this was written.
record.actedHeading: Acted on by {author} in this window
record.actedEmpty: No recorded action by {author} in this window.
record.actedUnread: The actions of this window could not be listed. See the source lines below.
record.dropped: Not frozen, because they were not in the snapshot: {keys}.

table.label: Open items frozen with this handover

source.failed: {name}: not read. It failed to load when this was written, so its rows are missing, not absent.
source.forbidden: {name}: not read. The author's account lacks {permission}, so its rows are not in this record.
source.forbiddenUnknown: {name}: not read. The author's account may not read it, so its rows are not in this record.
source.notCollected: {name}: not collected when this was written, so its rows are missing, not absent.
source.stale: {name}: read from data that was already old when this was written.
source.partial: {name}: partly read. Some rows or fields are missing from this record.

earlier.heading: Earlier handovers
earlier.label: Earlier handovers
earlier.author: Author
earlier.failed: The earlier handovers could not be loaded.

compose.title: Write a handover
compose.forbidden: Writing a handover needs the anomaly:triage permission. Nothing was saved. Ask an administrator for it.
compose.unknownPerm: Your permissions could not be read, so writing is off. Nothing was saved. Reload to try again.
compose.noteHint: What the next shift needs to know. Notes cannot be edited or deleted; a correction is a new handover.
compose.previewLoading: Reading the rows that would be frozen…
compose.previewFailed: The rows to freeze could not be loaded, so no row can be marked Watch. Retry. Saving the note still freezes the open rows as they are at that moment.
compose.previewEmpty: No open rows would be frozen right now.
compose.watchLimit: {max} rows are watched, the most a handover holds. Clear one to watch another.
compose.saved: Handover saved. It cannot be edited.
compose.savedDropped: Handover saved. {count} watched rows were not in the snapshot and were not frozen: {keys}.
compose.saveFailedNetwork: The handover was not saved: the backend did not answer. Your note is still here. Retry.
compose.saveFailedServer: The handover was not saved: the backend failed. Your note is still here. Retry.
compose.saveFailedExpired: The handover was not saved: your session has expired. Sign in again; your note is still here.
compose.saveFailedForbidden: The handover was not saved. You need the anomaly:triage permission.
compose.partial: Some sources could not be read for this preview. The handover would be saved with them marked as not read.
compose.description: Freeze what is open now and leave a note for the next shift.

widget.title: Latest handover
widget.incompleteTitle: A source was not read cleanly when this was written: {sources}.
widget.label: Latest handover

preview.failed: {name}: not read. It failed to load for this preview, so its rows would be missing, not absent.
preview.forbidden: {name}: not read. Your account lacks {permission}, so its rows would not be in this handover.
preview.forbiddenUnknown: {name}: not read. Your account may not read it, so its rows would not be in this handover.
preview.notCollected: {name}: not collected for this preview, so its rows would be missing, not absent.
preview.stale: {name}: read from data that is already old, so this handover would carry that age.
preview.partial: {name}: partly read. Some rows or fields would be missing from this handover.
